# mimecast_pending_domains (Data Source)

Read all pending domains with cursor pagination. Verification tokens are deliberately excluded from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_pending_domains" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `created_date_time` (String) Pending-domain creation time.
- `domain` (String) Domain name.
- `expiry_date_time` (String) Pending-domain verification expiry time.
- `id` (String) Domain ID.
- `inbound_type` (String) Inbound validation mode.
- `local` (Boolean) Whether the domain is local.
- `send_only` (Boolean) Whether the domain is send-only.
